title: Exploring Middle-Aged Women’s Post-Session Perceptions of Generative AI Utilization
content: Generative AI is transforming professional and educational landscapes, necessitating competency in generative AI. This study explores middle-aged women’s perceptions of generative AI after participating in an educational program that integrates theoretical concepts with hands-on prompt engineering exercises. The program was based on instructional design principles, including generative AI activities. A mixed-methods approach was employed, integrating both post-session surveys and open-ended responses. The study involved 11 women aged 30-50 enrolled in a career development training program in Seoul, South Korea. Descriptive statistics were applied to analyze the quantitative data, while thematic analysis was employed for the qualitative data. Findings indicate that participants recognized the potential of generative AI to enhance work efficiency and career mobility, reporting high satisfaction and trust in AI-generated outputs. Additionally, participants emphasized the need for critical judgment in evaluating AI-generated content. This study offers insights into designing effective educational programs that utilize generative AI to support the career transitions of middle-aged women in an AI-driven era.
